facts.fact: The IPDCP says Togo's law no. 2019-014 of 29 October 2019 sets the legal framework for collecting, processing and using personal data, and that it was promulgated on that date.
The IPDCP, Togo's Instance de Protection des Donnees a Caractere Personnel, says it organises the first national data protection day on 29 October 2026.
